headline: Kratz homer, Pierre walk-off single stun Cardinals in 11th
recap: Juan Pierre's two-out single up the middle in the bottom of the 11th inning scored Jimmy Rollins and gave the Phillies an 8-7 win over the St. Louis Cardinals. Erik Kratz opened the inning with a double, Jimmy Rollins reached on a fielder's choice that retired Kratz at third, and Brian Schneider's groundout moved Rollins to second before Pierre's hit ended it.

Phillies starter Vance Worley allowed nine hits and four runs over five and a third innings with four strikeouts, while Cardinals starter Lance Lynn gave up four runs on four hits over five innings. Philadelphia built an early 3-0 lead in the first on a Chase Utley triple and a Ryan Howard RBI single, and Howard's solo home run in the fourth tied the game at 4-4 after St. Louis had pulled even.

St. Louis retook the lead with a three-run eighth off reliever Michael Schwimer, capped by a two-run double from Jon Jay and an RBI single from Matt Carpenter, but Erik Kratz answered in the bottom half with a three-run homer off Mitchell Boggs, who was working a save chance, to tie it 7-7. Jeremy Horst worked two scoreless innings in relief to earn the win, and Barret Browning took the loss.
